title: Rural Home Loans Returned-Payment Fee Schedule by Returns Counted
content:
Schedule of the returned-payment fee on a Rural Home Loans loan by the number of other returned remittances counted.

## Schedule

The fee for a returned remittance whose return reason is not unauthorized depends on the other returned remittances counted: with three or more, the fee is 45.00 USD; with two, it is 40.00 USD; with exactly one, it is 35.00 USD; with none, it is the product's returned payment fee; a remittance returned as unauthorized carries no fee.

| Return reason | Other returned remittances counted | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| not unauthorized | three or more | 45.00 |
| not unauthorized | two | 40.00 |
| not unauthorized | exactly one | 35.00 |
| not unauthorized | none | the product's returned payment fee |
| unauthorized | any number | no fee |

## Reading the schedule

- The count is of other returned remittances; the remittance the fee is for is not one of them.
- *Hypothetical cases:* with two other returns counted and a return reason of insufficient funds, the fee is 40.00; with five other returns counted, it is 45.00, the top of the schedule; with three returns counted but a return reason of unauthorized, there is no fee.
